biotools.summary: GLiNER-BioMed is a suite of models designed for open biomedical named entity recognition (NER). It utilizes both uni- and bi-encoder architectures to efficiently extract entities like genes, proteins, and sequences from biomedical text.
biotools.name: GLiNER-BioMed: Open Biomedical Named Entity Recognition Suite
